title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording indicator for call queue calls on mobile
summary: The briefing accurately describes the mobile banner change, Microsoft's rollout window and the lack of required admin action. Minor clarifications are needed around conflicting recording prerequisites, UI versus PowerShell template defaults, and a warning in the PowerShell reference.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Representatives answering automatically recorded call queue calls in Teams on mobile will see the updated recording banner.
claims.quote: Once available, calling reps who answer call queue calls that are automatically recorded by your organization will see the updated message in the recording banner in Teams on Mobile.

claims.claim: The mobile indicator will say that recording and transcription started automatically.
claims.quote: Teams on Mobile will clearly indicate that recording and transcription have started automatically and cannot be stopped.

claims.claim: The indicator tells representatives that they cannot stop automatic recording and transcription.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams on Mobile will clearly indicate that recording and transcription have started automatically and cannot be stopped.

claims.claim: The mobile change makes the recording-state experience consistent with the existing desktop experience.
claims.quote: Automatic recording for call queues is already available on desktop and is configured by admins in Teams admin center. Mobile now shows the same recording state.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this mobile automatic call queue recording banner.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "Mobile" "banner" "automatically" "recording" "call queue"; opened the cited automatic recording setup and planning pages and teams-compliance-recording-custom-banner. The latter covers compliance recording, not this indicator.

claims.claim: When enabled, Automatic Recording for Call Queue records inbound calls automatically when a representative answers.
claims.quote: When enabled, all inbound call queue calls are automatically recorded when a representative (agent) answers.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Assign a queue's automatic recording template in Teams admin center under Voice > Call queue > queue > Templates tab > Automatic recording template.
claims.quote:
go to **Voice** > **Call queue**.
2. Select the call queue you want to have automatic recording for.
3. On the **Templates** tab, scroll to find the **Automatic recording template** section.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table and closing notes
claims.claim: The MicrosoftTeams Set-CsCallQueue cmdlet's AutoRecordingTemplateId parameter assigns an automatic recording template to a queue.
claims.quote:
Voice applications private preview customers only.

Saving a call queue configuration through Teams admin center will remove this setting.

The AutoRecordingTemplateId parameter indicates the Auto Recording template to apply to the call queue.
claims.fix: Add the reference's warning to this control's note: 'The PowerShell reference also warns that saving the queue through Teams admin center removes this setting; this differs from the setup page documenting assignment through that UI.' Keep the existing private-preview discrepancy warning.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Create an automatic recording template in Teams admin center under Voice > Templates and resources > Templates > Automatic Recording > Add.
claims.quote:
go to **Voice** > **Templates and resources**.
2. Select **Templates**.
3. Select **Automatic Recording** as the template type.
4. Select **Add** to create a new Automatic Recording template.

claims.claim: MicrosoftTeams New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate creates a template, with Name, RecordingEnabled and TranscriptionEnabled parameters.
claims.quote:
New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate
    -Name <String>
    -Description <String>
    -SharePointHostName <String>
    -SharePointSiteName <String>
    -RecordingDocumentOwner <String>
    [-TranscriptionEnabled <Boolean>]
    [-RecordingEnabled <Boolean>]

claims.claim: No UI or API control is documented for this mobile banner's wording or for disabling the new banner.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams mobile call queue automatic recording indicator banner wording disable policy PowerShell; opened automatic recording setup, planning, Set-CsCallQueue and custom compliance banner docs. CustomBanner governs compliance recording, not this automatic recording banner.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Licensing for the mobile banner change itself is not yet published, so its licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams mobile call queue automatic recording indicator banner licensing price meter; read MC1552392, the roadmap, automatic recording setup, planning and voice applications licensing. None specifies licensing for the banner change itself.

claims.claim: No meter is published for this banner change.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams mobile call queue automatic recording indicator banner licensing price meter; opened voice applications licensing, recording planning and template setup; read the roadmap and MC1552392. No banner-specific meter is stated.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing page says Automatic Recording for Call Queue requires no extra Teams Phone licensing.
claims.quote:
### Automatic Recording for Call Queue

- No extra Teams Phone licensing is required.
- See [SharePoint service description]

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: All Queues App users require a Teams Premium licence.
claims.quote: All [Queues App](manage-queues-app) users require a [Teams Premium](teams-add-on-licensing/licensing-enhance-teams) license.

claims.claim: The Automatic Recording template setup page says users require Queues App to access the features described there.
claims.quote: Users require [Queues App](manage-queues-app) to access the features described in this article.

claims.claim: The underlying recording feature requires conference mode enabled on the queue.
claims.quote: [Conference mode](aa-cq-setup-call-queue#conference-mode) is enabled on the call queue.

claims.claim: The setup page permits a group or channel for call answering with automatic recording.
claims.quote: [Call answering](aa-cq-setup-call-queue#step-3-call-answering)must use a group or channel.
claims.fix: Report the documentation disagreement: 'The template setup page says group or channel, while the Automatic Recording for Call Queue prerequisites at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/aa-cq-reference-prerequisites-licensing say to use Microsoft 365 security groups to assign representatives.' Do not silently choose between them.

claims.claim: The template setup page says Users-based call answering is unsupported for automatic recording.
claims.quote: Users and Shifts are not supported

claims.claim: Shifts-based call answering is unsupported for automatic recording.
claims.quote: Users and Shifts are not supported

claims.claim: Shared Call History must be enabled on the queue for the underlying recording feature.
claims.quote: [Shared Call History](aa-cq-setup-call-queue-template-shared-history)in enabled on the call queue.

claims.claim: Explicit recording consent must be Off for the underlying recording feature.
claims.quote: [Explicit recording consent](participant-agreement-recording-transcription) must be **Off**.

claims.claim: The template's default caller announcement is 'This call will be recorded.'
claims.quote: The default announcement is: `This call will be recorded.`

claims.claim: Assigning a template requires the Teams administrator also to be a SharePoint site administrator for its site.
claims.quote: To assign an automatic recording template to a call queue or manage its authorized users list, the Teams administrator must also be a SharePoint site administrator for the site used by the template.

claims.claim: Recording is enabled by default when creating an automatic recording template.
claims.quote: Call recording is enabled by default. Disable call recording if required.
claims.fix: Qualify this as creation in Teams admin center. The cited New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate reference instead lists RecordingEnabled's default as False; the UI default should not be presented as applying to all creation methods.

claims.claim: Transcription is enabled by default when creating an automatic recording template.
claims.quote: Transcription is enabled by default. Disable transcription if required.
claims.fix: Qualify this as creation in Teams admin center. The cited New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate reference instead lists TranscriptionEnabled's default as False; retain the explicit PowerShell parameter in the control row.

claims.claim: The template's SharePoint host setting cannot be modified after creation.

Enter the **SharePoint host name**.

claims.claim: The template's SharePoint site setting cannot be modified after creation.
claims.quote:

claims.claim: The setup page lists PowerShell configuration for Automatic Recording for Call Queue from August 13, 2026.

claims.where: controls[1].governs and note; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The automatic recording template governs recording, transcription, caller announcements and storage rather than the new mobile banner wording.
claims.quote: An automatic recording template for Call Queue defines where, in SharePoint, recordings and transcripts will be stored, the prompts played to callers to let them know that recording is enabled, and defines who has access to the recordings.

claims.claim: The cited Learn documentation provides no storage-cost figure specifically for these recordings and transcripts.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams mobile call queue automatic recording indicator banner licensing price meter; opened voice applications licensing, recording planning and automatic recording template setup. Licensing links to the SharePoint service description but gives no recording-specific storage price.
